source: A small, enclosed post-apocalyptic zombie arena, ruined and abandoned, with rubble, broken walls, and debris. Expose attributes for wall height, rubble density, and floor color.
scene_prompt: Create a small, enclosed post-apocalyptic zombie arena with a ruined, abandoned interior. Broken perimeter walls surround the space, with rubble and debris scattered across the floor and clustered along the damaged walls. Make wall height, rubble density, and floor color adjustable.
blob:
### Genre
`Action` is dominant: the zombie arena implies a close-quarters combat space. No secondary genre is needed.

### Shape and preset
Use `arena-flat`, a compact, single-level enclosed fighting floor whose ruined perimeter defines the combat bowl. Match the Boss Raid preset only in its compact hostile-arena character, but use preset none because the prompt does not request enemy emitters, breakable structures, or ring-out edges.

### Config requirements
No menu options are selected beyond the shape: the prompt asks for a ruined visual treatment, not tactical cover, hazards, spawns, or other gameplay geometry. All specified build elements are visible geometry. There are no invisible trigger volumes, spawn markers, pickups, or emitters. Expose wall height, rubble density, and floor color as adjustable visual parameters; they must alter the rendered broken-wall height, debris coverage, and main floor material/color respectively.

### Layout components
Build one small, roughly square or slightly rectangular ruined arena floor, occupying most of the frame. A continuous but heavily broken perimeter wall encloses it on all sides; leave irregular collapsed sections and jagged wall stumps, but no open route beyond the boundary. Scatter rubble and debris across the central floor at the selected density, keeping the broad central area visually readable. Cluster denser piles of masonry, shattered wall slabs, and abandoned debris along the damaged perimeter, especially near collapsed wall sections. Use a flat floor with the selected floor color, weathered and dirty rather than clean. There is no water, terrain relief, interior transition, or separate zone. Compose from an elevated three-quarter view so the entire enclosure, wall height, central floor, and rubble distribution read at once.

### Render order
Use `isometric`: the ruined visual atmosphere and readable enclosed arena silhouette lead, while the simple single-floor plan can be projected afterward.

### Scale, theme, and pipeline cost
Scale is small, driven by one compact enclosed arena. Theme: abandoned post-apocalyptic ruin, cracked masonry, dusty debris, desaturated industrial floor. Use `P0`; this is one flat, visible surface with no overhangs, indoor/outdoor transition, separate maps, or topology that must be constructed procedurally.
